criteria.name: Non-text content
criteria.evidence: axe button-name (critical) on all 10 stories: the icon svg is aria-hidden, so iconAriaTitle (set as its title) never names the button; the Keyboard story sets it and still fails
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): put iconAriaTitle (or a default "More information") on the button as aria-label.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on Open, where the tooltip text shows

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Content on hover or focus
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab shows the tooltip, Escape hides it; aria-describedby ties the content to the button

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play) and Playwright Tab run at 1280, 390 and 320: Tab focuses the button and opens the tooltip

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run and screenshot: 2px #000 outline with a white ring

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: the tooltip opens to the side and leaves the button visible

criteria.name: Target size (minimum)
criteria.evidence: measured: 20x20 (16x17 inside Table headers), under 24x24 but nothing else within 24px in the stories (spacing exception)
criteria.note: Placed next to another target it would fail; check dense rows.

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: same root as 1.1.1: a button with no name
criteria.note: Fixed by the same heal as 1.1.1.
